reason: 该插件的主要用户-facing 目的为协助在 DSH 中按 agentskills.io 规范编写 SKILL.md 技能文件，基于 README 中的“创建技能/写 SKILL.md”触发与按澄清-起草-充实-校验-交付流程的说明，以及 package.json 与仓库结构中对 skill-creator 模块和引用材料的提供，归类为插件开发类工具。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DSH 中按 agentskills.io 规范协助 agent 生成和完善 SKILL.md 技能文件。
summaries.en: This plugin helps an agent create and refine SKILL.md skill files in DSH according to agentskills.io conventions.

capabilities: Assist an agent in generating SKILL.md skill definitions
Guide SKILL.md creation in a structured step-by-step flow
Include and reference skill-writing templates/notes for frontmatter and descriptions
Ship as a DSH plugin via bundle patch manifest

reasons.code: README states automatic loading when user asks to create/write SKILL.md and outputs a complete skill in a guided flow
Package manifest exposes a DSH bundle patch entrypoint, confirming plugin integration
Repository structure includes skills/skill-creator and reference docs used for skill authoring guidance
